mentions.name: Hence
mentions.description: This free online daily puzzle game is a modern twist on Einstein's puzzle, using fun picture clues instead of text. Each day's puzzle is the same for everyone and is run through a verifier to guarantee it is solvable by pure deduction with no guessing. It includes a hint system and requires no account to play; it launched October 5.
